senses.gloss: ऋष्य ऋष्य, m. The painted or white-footed antelope, Bhāg. P. 3, 31, 36; in ऋष्यरूपिन्, i. e. -रूप + इन्, adj. Having the shape of an antelope. In the Veda it is written ऋश्य; cf. O.H.G. elah; ἄλκη.
ऋष्यक ऋष्य + क, adj. Of the colour of the painted antelope, Rām. 5, 12, 35.
ऋष्यमूक ऋष्य-मूक, m. The name of a mountain, Rām. 1, 3, 22.
